answer: The delta multiplier is published, charged in willow, and pigment lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 19 for each member already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival forfeits the most. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. A farm of 1069 identities would post 4469 proofs and burn roughly 66 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
